change: StudioFxSuite refuses returned lazy cats.effect.IO through MUnit ValueTransform, instead of accepting a false green or starting an action after fixture cleanup. Existing explicit IO execution and returned Futures remain supported.
reason: Three newly authored native resource tests returned IO under FunSuite without executing it; corrected in the native-platform slice. MUnit documents lazy effect handling as an opt-in; this is a local harness guard, not an upstream defect.

tests.mutation: Change the IO match to Promise so IO is no longer rejected: both canaries fail. Restore the IO match: both pass. Actual FX fixture canary uses the expected-failure tag; if an IO result is ignored, that canary fails.
tests.no_execution: The direct transformer test also proves the rejected IO did not run. MUnit wraps the assertion; the test checks the complete causal reason.

limits: Focused validation only; the complete native suite must run with this guard in the combined qualification.
No scientific data, plot output, runtime backend or public library API changed.
